deployments_detail.use: Zebra Mobile Computing AI Suite: an AI data-capture SDK and example apps that let developers embed vision-AI capabilities into mobile applications on select Zebra Android devices, enabling frontline workers to capture workflow context accurately. [Zebra Technologies]
"Aurora Vision" machine-vision software + Vision AI for autonomous warehouse item recognition/scanning

Walgreens deployed Zebra Workcloud Forecasting & Analysis (formerly Zebra demand forecasting), an AI-powered demand-forecasting platform that fuses weather, social trends and local events with retail data to forecast demand across 8,000+ stores, analyzing 50+ variables per SKU across 180M distribution points. [Zebra Workcloud (Zebra Technologies)]
deployments_detail.value: Forecast error reduced 15 percentage points; over-forecasting cut from 15% to 1%; 50% reduction in human intervention; 98% in-stock levels during demand surges; deployed since 2017

deployments_detail.use: Target, with Zebra, Google Cloud and Qualcomm, is exploring a GenAI 'Merchandising Agent' that lets store staff photograph a shelf and get millisecond real-time insights on stock levels, out-of-stocks and misplaced items, running on-device AI on Zebra TC5 Series mobile computers with cloud AI from Google Cloud. [Zebra Technologies + Google Cloud (Gemini) + Qualcomm]

Zebra Companion, a multimodal GenAI suite of frontline-worker agents (Knowledge Agent, Sales Agent, Device Agent, Merchandising Agent) running on Zebra Android devices, providing conversational SOP access, product/inventory queries, device troubleshooting and on-device shelf image recognition. Powered by Google Cloud Gemini models. [Zebra Technologies + Google Cloud (Gemini) + Qualcomm]

Sentinel deployed a 'Poka Yoke' automotive door-panel quality-control inspection machine built on Zebra AltiZ 3D profile sensors and a hybrid AI-plus-rule-based vision system (integrated via Zebra reseller ClearView), replacing hundreds of mechanical sensors with vision AI inspection. [Zebra Technologies (AltiZ) + ClearView integrator]
deployments_detail.value: Commissioning time cut from 3 months to 3 weeks; defect rates lowered 10-15%; ~500 mechanical sensors eliminated; 100+ inspection points analyzed in 30 seconds

deployments_detail.use: Zebra added deep-learning AI tools to its Aurora machine vision software suite (Design Assistant, Vision Studio, Imaging Library): no-code deep-learning object detection, font-independent OCR, and unsupervised anomaly/defect detection for industrial inspection in automotive, electronics, semiconductor, food/beverage and packaging. [Zebra Aurora (Zebra Technologies); GPU add-ons for NVIDIA and Intel]

Zebra demonstrated on-device generative AI (an open-source GenAI model) running locally on its mobile computers and tablets powered by Qualcomm chipsets, applied to voice AI, computer vision and machine-vision workflows, for privacy, security and cost benefits at the mobile edge. [Zebra Technologies + Qualcomm Technologies]

Zebra partnered with Google Cloud, Android and Qualcomm to unveil generative AI capabilities (using Google's Gemini and open-source Gemma models) spanning on-device to cloud, reducing cognitive load on frontline employees; announced at Google Cloud Next '24. [Zebra Technologies + Google Cloud (Gemini/Gemma) + Qualcomm + Android]

Walgreens deployed Zebra Workcloud Actionable Intelligence (formerly Zebra Prescriptive Analytics), an AI/ML anomaly-detection platform that flags inventory anomalies, fraud, compliance issues and loss-prevention risks across 9,000+ stores and issues real-time corrective-action alerts to associates. [Zebra Workcloud (Zebra Technologies)]
deployments_detail.value: 20,000+ users at Walgreens; 27% reduction in waste rates; millions of dollars saved; 500+ cashiers with irregular ID-verification patterns flagged within 24 hours
